title: CodeBlock
description: A read-only block of preformatted text (logs, payloads, config) in a named, keyboard-focusable scroll region.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Text is rendered verbatim and long lines wrap by default.

no-wrap.title: Scrolling logs
no-wrap.description: wrap={false} keeps lines intact and scrolls horizontally; maxHeight bounds the block.

copyable.title: Copy button
copyable.description: copyable adds a copy button in the top-right corner; the result ("Copied" / "Copy failed") is shown on the button and announced to screen readers. onCopied receives the copied text after a successful copy.

CodeBlockProps.aria-label: Accessible name of the code region
CodeBlockProps.wrap: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally
CodeBlockProps.maxHeight: Maximum height before the block scrolls
CodeBlockProps.tabIndex: Tab order of the region (focusable by default)
CodeBlockProps.copyable: Shows a copy button that writes the text to the clipboard and announces the result
CodeBlockProps.onCopied: Called with the copied text after the copy button wrote it to the clipboard (not on failure); the native onCopy still goes to the element

cssVars.--code-block-max-height: Maximum height before the block scrolls (default: none)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The text content is rendered verbatim (escape < in markup); language shows a label. Each block is a named, focusable region.

copy.title: Copy to clipboard
copy.description: The code property holds the text; copyable adds a copy button, copy() copies from outside and minerva-copy reports the result.

overflow.title: Long lines and height
overflow.description: no-wrap scrolls long lines horizontally and max-height caps the block; the region scrolls with the keyboard too.

props.code: Source text (default: the element's text content).
props.language: Language of the code, shown as a label (e.g. "json", "bash").
props.noWrap: Scrolls long lines horizontally instead of wrapping them (the React library's wrap={false}).

events.minerva-copy: The copy button or copy() was used (detail: { text, success }; text is the copied text, React's onCopied receives it on success).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the copy button on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of a pressed copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of a pressed copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the copy button.
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Font size of the copy icon.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the copy button.

methods.copy: Copies the text to the clipboard; resolves with whether it worked.
